reason: H0 exclusively initializes and exercises wuffs_json__decoder and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson. It neither compiles the VP8 or WebP modules nor invokes the new base.image_decoder implementation or the WebP VP8-lossy delegation path. Consequently, VP8 bitstream parsing, image-decoder call-sequence transitions, restart behavior, destination pixel-buffer/swizzler handling, and streamed short-read behavior are untested.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__AUX__JSON, but no VP8 or WebP module.
H0's production entry points are wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; it contains no base.image_decoder calls.
S1 introduces vp8.decoder implementing base.image_decoder with decode_image_config?, decode_frame_config?, decode_frame?, and restart_frame!.
S1 adds parsing of VP8 frame-tag/header fields, including the non-key-frame bit, the '\x9D\x01\x2A' signature, width, and height.
S1 routes WebP 'VP8 ' chunks through this.vp8.decode_image_config?, this.vp8.decode_frame_config?, and this.vp8.decode_frame? when is_vp8_lossy is true.
S1's decode_frame? prepares a pixel swizzler and calls make_a_placeholder_gradient!, which writes according to destination pixel format, palette, plane rows, width, height, and blend.
recommended_action: Add an image-decoder fuzz harness for standalone vp8.decoder and webp.decoder 'VP8 ' inputs. Exercise fragmented and closed readers, malformed/truncated headers and chunk lengths, the decode_image_config? → decode_frame_config? → decode_frame? protocol, invalid and valid restart_frame! calls, multiple destination pixel formats/strides/palettes and blend values, and validate status, bounds, progress, and decoded-frame counters.
